facts.fact: StackAdapt announced on December 6, 2022 that its clients now have access to expanded location targeting and analytics through its partnership with location data provider Precisely PlaceIQ.
facts.quote: StackAdapt ([www.stackadapt.com](https://www.stackadapt.com/)), a programmatic advertising company, announced that clients now have access to expanded location targeting and analytics through their partnership

facts.fact: Media buyers in North America using the StackAdapt platform have access to daily updated location performance data through the PlaceIQ partnership.
facts.quote: Media buyers in North America who are leveraging the StackAdapt platform now have access to daily updated location performance data

facts.fact: StackAdapt users can target specific location-based audiences through multi-channel advertising across display, native, video, connected TV (CTV), and audio.
facts.quote: Target specific location-based audiences through multi-channel advertising across display, native, video, connected TV (CTV), and audio.

facts.fact: StackAdapt users can forecast foot traffic trends at specific commercial locations through Precisely PlaceIQ.
facts.quote: Forecast trends for foot traffic at specific commercial locations through Precisely PlaceIQ.
